# Madagascar

Values for an OG-Core calibration, then the estimates behind them. How to use them: [calibration guide](../calibration-guide.md).

## Values for OG-Core

| OG-Core input | Wealth gradient | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `fert_gradient` | −1.07, by age as below | DHS 2021, TFR, plus [age offsets](../methods/fertility-by-age.md) |
| `infmort_gradient` | −0.38 | DHS 2021, infant mortality rate |
| `mort_gradient` | −0.23 (95% prediction interval −0.94 to 0.48) | [general gradient](../methods/general-gradient.md) at GDP per capita (PPP, constant 2021 international $) of $1,668 (2025, World Bank) |
